title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori! I'll have these snacks for snacktime today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right, do you have your stamp rally sheet?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sure do! Did you make a stamp too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm pretty proud of it♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see, my spot is here and down and... Stamp!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, this doggy...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's Samo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I made it using Samo as live reference!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew it! You even included his paw pads. This is sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Minori, do you know what the heart shape and teardrop shape in these two boxes are?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, um, those...
Those are for our stamps, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi! Shizuku! Thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, you said stamps?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Haruka and the others told us all about the plan, so we made some too. Shall we stamp them for you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Of course! Please do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's start with mine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here's your special Airi...heart stamp!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! So many hearts! It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it even has your name in the design too! Oh, I'm going to treasure this forever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you like it. And keep on being a great fan, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!
After school
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're making great progress on the stamp rally.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I got Minori's, Airi's, and Shizuku's over lunch, so I only have two left to go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never thought I'd get stamps from these two... I'm really looking forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've already contacted them, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. I just got a message saying they'd arrived, so they should be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Kanade! Asahina!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There you are. I'm glad we found you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday. Sorry to make you come all the way out here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not at all! I'm very glad I got to see you two on my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to see you too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right. We have stamps for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wasn't really sure what would be best, so mine is kind of standard... But here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Please allow me, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you both very much!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also... Here, this is for you. Your present. Mafuyu and I picked it out together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, a present from the two of you?! Um, can I open it right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, a ribbon scrunchie!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We asked Ms. Mochizuki and Hoshino for advice on the color and so on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you did?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The ribbon is so frilly and cute, and the ivory color feels energizing... This is just perfect! I'll start wearing it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Great.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, too! Ichi, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, we should probably get going. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you both so, so much!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... Is it really okay for this many good things to happen in one day?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why not? You only get one birthday a year.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't forget, you still have one last present.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One last...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! The stamp rally prize!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that you've collected all the stamps, Saki, here's a present from the three of us to you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? A ticket? Let's see...
“This ticket can be exchanged for anything Saki Tenma wishes”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Anything? You mean anything anything?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anything we can make happen, at least.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And no “I wish for infinite wishes” stuff either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, I wasn't going to say that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, a ticket for anything! What should I use it for?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not like it expires, so you don't have to use it right away—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I've got it! I wanna buy disposable cameras and hold a photoshoot with everyone! Right now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A photoshoot?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, just look around! Isn't this dusky lighting so perfect? We could take some awesome photos together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's been such a super awesome day! I want some photos to remember it by!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That sounds like a plan, then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But where do they even sell disposable cameras nowadays?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Probably an appliance store?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, then! Let's all go to the appliance store♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki! I heard all about your stamp rally from Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make a birthday stamp of my own when I get home. I'll buy you a present too, so look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki. Handmade stamps are such a wonderful idea. You truly have good friends.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure that speaks to your own good qualities as a person, too. All the best and keep on shining, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakiii! I said it already this morning, but I'll say it a thousand times! Happy birthdaaay!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tenma. I'm sorry I couldn't join the fun; we had rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's celebrate properly the next time we meet up. Let's go out for sweets or something sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, that's a great idea! Okay, then... I'll invite you to an all-you-can-eat buffet☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Then I'll bring you to a gourmet barbeque place, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll come up with a special surprise for after each meal. Three meals means...quite a few chances to try new things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Saki! I was so happy you liked my stamp!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All the stamps were so cute. Everyone's personalities really came through in their designs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I liked Shizuku's stamp best, myself. You did a little picture of Saki in the middle, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I imparted it with my best wishes for her to keep having wonderful days with Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Happy birthday, Tenma. I'm glad you liked your present.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Saki♪
Hope this next year's a great one for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also hey, if you two were going to give Saki a present you should have told me! I wanted to help brainstorm too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, sorry about that. We'll loop you in next time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Pinky promise me!
Saki! I'll have a present for you too next time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy you enjoyed your stamp rally.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll have to thank everyone again for agreeing to help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, to think she used her ticket on a photoshoot... Well, as long as she had fun, it's fine by me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She said she'll get the photos developed soon. I can't wait to see how they turned out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, Saki! Here's to many more years together, as bandmates and as friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you all so much for today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got so many warm wishes from my family and my friends. I'm so happy, I feel like my heart might burst!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So just wait! I'll pay back all this happiness to all of you... No, I'll bring you even more than I got!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll bring happiness to everyone, with our music and our shows! We've got so much more in store!
